displayedOptions.name: Quiet Graphite
displayedOptions.prompt:
Generate a new, high-quality Korean mobile travel-app component using only this text brief. Target 390 × 240 logical pixels. Show exactly two concise reservation panels side by side, with equal dimensions and a narrow gap.

Art direction: quiet graphite utility. Use a warm light-gray outer canvas, deep graphite panels, soft-white primary text, carefully contrasted gray supporting text, a small mint accent for transport and a small muted-coral accent for accommodation. Use controlled corner radii, fine tonal separators and small precise line icons. The result should feel sophisticated, calm and professionally engineered, with crisp digital rendering and optically aligned Korean typography. Avoid physical textures, ornamental illustrations, glass effects and dramatic shadows.

Keep category headings around 15 pixels, main content 14–16 pixels and supporting text 12 pixels. Put the category and compact booking count in the top row. In transport, emphasize the route and group the carrier and date beneath it. In accommodation, show two short name-and-date rows.
